logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.

moments.description: Prudence urgently warns Lady Juliana about the dangers of Ashbury Manor, but Juliana remains defiantly focused on saving the dying Duchess.
moments.key_dialogue: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.

moments.description: The formidable Housekeeper intercepts Prudence and interrogates disguised Lady Juliana, suspicious of her soft appearance.
The Housekeeper steps menacingly into Lady Juliana's face, threatening her to keep her eyes and ears where they belong.
moments.key_dialogue: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?

moments.description: Lady Juliana successfully sneaks into the forbidden West Wing and discovers the frail Dowager Duchess struggling to breathe in a shadowy bedchamber.
Lady Juliana checks the Duchess's pulse and is struck by the horrifying realization that her condition is caused by foul play rather than natural fever.
The Dowager Duchess convulses violently as Lady Juliana desperately demands to know who has been treating her, ending on a suspenseful note.
